Our Story

BeFit Marketing was founded with a single vision: to provide athletes and sports enthusiasts in Sri Lanka with the highest quality sports gear and accessories. From cricket bats to fitness equipment, we’ve carefully curated a selection of over 50 top-tier brands, including our proud partnership as the authorized dealer of SG Cricket. Our dedication to excellence and customer satisfaction has made us a trusted name in the industry.

As we continue to grow, our commitment remains the same: to deliver authentic products that enhance performance, durability, and enjoyment in every sport. Whether you're a professional athlete or a beginner, BeFit Marketing is here to support your journey with expert advice, top-notch service, and the best equipment available. Join us in celebrating the spirit of sports and performance!

Befit indoor sports complex

Befit Indoor Sports Academy situated in Mawanella, is one of the largest indoor grounds in Sri Lanka with gym, futsal, cricket, and badminton under one roof. It is used as an academy to train young athletes in their respective sports. We also have branches in Hemmathagama, Paragahadeniya, and Warakapola. Our services are well-maintained and are given access through booking.

a wide variety of sports and fitness products to meet your every need. We provide the perfect equipment or service for every stage of your fitness journey.

Mohammed Fairose

CEO

I am excited to share about our journey and the values that drive us this far. We established Befit marketing with the core intention of transforming the way people approach fitness and entertainment. This vision was the impact of our passion for sports and the desire to make a meaningful impact in people’s lives. Our goal has always been to give more than our customers’ expectations. Over the years we have grown and evolved, but still, our principles stayed the same. Looking forward we are more dedicated to our plans. We believe together we achieve more. Thank you.

Why Choose Befit Marketing?

We Befit Marketing, pride ourselves in being your one-stop shop for sports equipment and all sporting needs. Be it fitness, team or individual sports, we have a wide range of products catering to all kinds of athletes, fitness enthusiasts, and businesses alike. Our energetic staffs are sporty individuals who are committed to providing exceptional service, helping you find the right equipment to meet your goals. We have competitive wholesale options that suit your needs for a smooth and profitable partnership, whether a wholesaler in need of stock or an individual wanting to acquire personal gear,

Befit showroom

Befit showrooms one in Mawanella town and another in Main Street Colombo serve as wholesale and retail dealers in all kinds of sports accessories, outdoor sports equipment, and gym accessories. That way it’s more convenient for our loyal customers. We are looking forward to extending our retail chain to serve across the country.

Mawanella

Located in the heart of Mawanella, our Mawanella showroom serves as a convenient destination for Retail customers in the region. Offering a wide range of sports accessories, outdoor sports equipment, and gym accessories, this location is perfect for those seeking quality products at competitive prices. Whether you're outfitting a team or looking for personal fitness gear, our Mawanella store is dedicated to providing tailored solutions to meet your needs.

Colombo

Situated in the bustling Main Street of Colombo, our flagship showroom caters to both wholesale and retail customers with a premium selection of sports and fitness gear. From high-end sports accessories to professional-grade outdoor sports equipment, this location is ideal for those seeking top-tier quality and expert advice. With a focus on delivering the best for athletes, fitness enthusiasts, and outdoor adventurers, the Colombo showroom offers a larger variety and personalized service to cater to urban clientele.
